versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the training-teacher-mgmt skill for comprehensive teacher management.
- Supports full lifecycle: lecturer information registration, qualification review, field classification, teaching records, evaluation & rating, fee standard, and schedule management.
- Provides clear input/output definitions, including lecturer profile cards and statistical reports.
- Outlines detailed workflows and a structured data model for robust lecturer archive management.
- Focuses on long-term teacher database operations, distinct from event-based scheduling or invitation.
